purpose: One bounded public collection page with editable bibliographic data/tags plus one formatted reference per item.
permission: A later operator must choose the authorized public collection and confirm intended use. This file makes no request and grants no access. Do not substitute the fictional keys as a real library.

capture_plan.identity: Preserve exact origin, group/collection locator and each returned item key; do not join solely by title or output order.
capture_plan.version: Record actual retrieval time, API version, Last-Modified-Version if supplied and item versions if supplied; keep unknown values explicit.
capture_plan.source: Retain permitted raw response bytes and SHA256 in the operator workspace before deriving output.
capture_plan.required_fields: Confirm actual data, tags and bibliographic-output locations in the returned structure; this blueprint does not assert a tested response schema.
capture_plan.completeness: This request is limited to3items. Record Total-Results, returned unique item count and any rel=next link. Unknown/missing/disagreeing coverage is incomplete or unassessed; do not silently fetch another page.
capture_plan.rendering: Returned bibliographic markup needs a separate safe rendering decision; linkwrap=0 is not a sanitizer.

stop: On unauthorized/private scope, unexpected structure, missing required data, error, backoff or uncertain result, preserve the limitation and stop. No automatic retry, pagination, upload or alternate integration.
